propositions: Ticket descriptions exceeding 8,000 characters must block both plan-review and completion-verification gates deterministically with zero LLM calls.
The maximum-description setting is configurable via typed [verify] configuration with a default of 8,000 characters; exactly 8,000 is allowed but 8,001 blocks.
Plan review returns deterministic BLOCK with coverage.llm_ran=false when description exceeds maximum; light-bug review retains P4 description block while downgrading other DET blocks to advisory.

Completion verification checks authoritative ticket description after loading [verify] setting and returns validated deterministic FAIL with zero runner calls if oversized, without truncating or eliding content.
AC-count and file-impact P4 signals remain advisory; the oversized-description finding is the only blocking P4 signal in this gate.
